execute_one_child_turn.designNote: This node executes one admitted native child turn. The reviewed surface union is 12 base Responses tools, humanagent_turn_end, three conditional parent child controls and humanagent_child_deliver in a child run. The union is not enabled on every request, and this binding does not claim live Provider exposure.

collect_turn_facts.designNote: Collect current-turn raw tool results, accepted evidence references, child adoption or non-selection decisions, failures, unresolved operations and recovery material. Historical typed ToolExecutionFact validation remains relevant evidence, but it is not a file.search-only gate and this graph does not claim that attachment is implemented.

derive_semantic_candidate.designNote: The model authors the four-part goal/actions/result/expectedNextStep semantic close and independently refined child deliveries. Runtime projects native semantic history and verifies evidence references. The native path does not require a deterministic per-tool SemanticClaim extractor or forced claims/constraints arrays. Failed, partial, truncated and unresolved outcomes remain distinct. Wire status is partial: captured two-turn/three-turn POST cases changed from RED 2/2 to GREEN 2/2 for existing checkpointId, committedAt, description and top-level evidenceRefs in v1. The v2 and child-run encoder branches are source-fixed but runtime UNVERIFIED. AdoptedChildSemanticContext/AdoptedChildSemanticDelivery have no evidenceRefs field; RefinedChildSemanticDelivery is a different existing type, no new child field was added, and the historical adopted-child evidenceRefs gap remains. Overall goal is not complete.

save_checkpoint_boundary.designNote: The checkpoint boundary commits the accepted four-part semantic summary, runtime-verified evidence references and adopted child refined deliveries through the existing checkpoint/control owner. No checkpoint, closure, durable turn receipt, next-turn, reentry or raw-release eligibility follows from this graph binding, raw bytes, replay or semantic prose. A local checkpointAndClosureCommitted fact is not full five-phase readiness; the five-phase coordinator decides separately.

assess_turn_disposition.designNote: UI projection replay is observation evidence only and is not authoritative Organ Journal state or recovery proof.
